graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary text, hairline borders, structural lines — the dominant neutral carrying all interface weight

ink.$description: Ink — Strongest text and most emphatic borders, logo dots, footer marks

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, nav backgrounds — the unbroken white field everything floats on

fog.$description: Fog — Muted helper text, secondary borders, dimmed metadata

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Sole chromatic accent — selected nav state, badge fills, a rare pressure point in an otherwise colorless system

gillsansnova-book.$description: Primary typeface for body, headings, nav, links, and icon-adjacent text — carries the entire English typographic system at a medium weight with wide tracking

gillsansnova-semibold.$description: Emphasis and key headings — the bolder weight creates hierarchy without size inflation; the 8px variant carries micro-labels and badge text

yu-gothic.$description: Japanese text rendering — sits at the same metric scale as the English system, ensuring bilingual visual parity

cezannepro-db.$description: Micro-decorative and brand-specific marks — a secondary display face for labels that need a different visual texture from the main Gill system

gillsansnova-medium.$description: GillSansNova-Medium — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
